body_markdown:
*Completed Acquisition Empowers Performance Marketers to Tap Into a Highly Specialized and Premium Ad Network Focused on Finance, Using Taboola’s Realize Platform*


**


** ** **New York, NY —**[Taboola](https://www.taboola.com/) (Nasdaq: TBLA), a global leader in delivering performance at scale for advertisers, today announced it has completed its


[previously announced](https://www.taboola.com/press-releases/dianomi/) acquisition of Dianomi, a leading provider of digital advertising services to premium clients in the business, finance and lifestyle sectors.


The completed acquisition bolsters Taboola’s ability to provide performance advertisers with a highly specialized, premium ad network focused on finance, using its Realize performance advertising platform. Realize leverages proprietary supply, first-party data, and AI to deliver scalable advertiser outcomes across major publishers.


Dianomi connects blue-chip advertisers—such as Charles Schwab, Invesco, and Bank of America—with high-intent audiences through major publishers including Reuters, CNN Business, and WSJ.


Trusted by over 600 advertisers and publishers, Dianomi expands Taboola’s brand-safe reach, providing marketers with more opportunities to connect with high-value business, finance, and lifestyle audiences.


“Combining Taboola’s Realize platform with Dianomi’s premium publisher network means more for advertisers seeking to connect with high-intent finance audiences,” said Adam Singolda, CEO of Taboola. “Together, we offer an even larger, trusted network of publishers and advertisers focused on finance. This is a win for advertisers seeking to connect with leaned in, finance-minded consumers on premium publishers, as well as for publishers that seek to connect with a deeper roster of blue-chip advertisers in the finance vertical.”


**About Taboola** **** Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.


Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching over 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News and Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.
